summary: Completed testing of Image Upload feature for restaurant specials. Backend API tests (8/8 passed) and frontend UI verification confirmed full functionality. Fixed 2 bugs during testing.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Image field was not included in specialData object sent to API
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added 'image: formData.image || null' to specialData in handleSubmit function

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Update endpoint was not preserving existing image when image field not provided
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Changed special_data.dict() to special_data.dict(exclude_unset=True) to only include explicitly set fields

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: update_special method needed better logic to handle image preservation
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added conditional logic to check if image key was explicitly provided vs defaulted to None

critical_code_review_comments: The OwnerAuth component still has excessive console.log debug statements that should be removed for production
seed_data_creation: Test specials prefixed with 'TEST_' were created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image upload feature is fully functional. Backend tests in /app/tests/test_image_upload.py cover all image CRUD scenarios. Frontend SpecialCreator modal has image upload section with file validation (max 1MB, images only). Images are stored as Base64 in MongoDB.

features_tested.create_special_with_image: PASS - POST /api/owners/specials with image field stores Base64 image
features_tested.create_special_without_image: PASS - POST /api/owners/specials without image field works correctly
features_tested.update_special_add_image: PASS - PUT /api/owners/specials/{id} can add image to existing special
features_tested.update_special_preserve_image: PASS - PUT /api/owners/specials/{id} preserves existing image when not provided
features_tested.update_special_remove_image: PASS - PUT /api/owners/specials/{id} with image:null removes image
features_tested.get_specials_returns_image: PASS - GET /api/owners/specials returns image field in response
features_tested.frontend_image_upload_ui: PASS - SpecialCreator modal shows image upload section with Choose Image button
features_tested.frontend_image_validation: PASS - Frontend validates image size (max 1MB) and type (images only)
